purpose: Research-only fixture parity check for the unchanged dashboard pattern and tradfi scanners; not an empirical market evaluation.

boundary_notes: Input rows are 1m candles; 5m mode aggregates only complete aligned groups of exactly five valid minute rows.
A bar is closed only when its timestamp plus one minute is no later than end; result end is the last fully closed target-cadence boundary.
A pullback has 2-4 consecutive bearish oriented closes, strictly decreasing closes, and needs at least 12 prior target-cadence bars before pullback.
Each candidate impulse length is 2-6 bars; ten immediately preceding bars form the baseline and the entire baseline-through-end segment must be contiguous.
Pullback status is emitted without a later confirmation bar; confirmed additionally requires a bullish close above trigger and a low strictly above pullback low.

Retracement bounds include 5% and configured maximum (default 50%); impulse quote-volume ratio must meet its threshold, while a quiet pullback requires pullback mean volume strictly below impulse mean volume.
not_supported: A directional argument or directions other than the built-in long/short scan
Frozen 11-arm family parity or a claim that this implementation covers all scanner outputs

boundary_notes: Consumes raw 1m-like rows, sorts timestamps, drops timestamps at or after end, and requires the last remaining candle timestamp to equal end minus 60,000ms.
Pullback lengths are tested in order 1-3 and impulse lengths 2-6; at least two rows precede impulse; impulse through final row must have exactly 60,000ms spacing.
Pullback bars must close below open; impulse bars must close above open in at least ceil(2/3 of bars).
Impulse percent uses close of last impulse relative to first impulse open; retracement includes 0% and 50%, while pullback low must be strictly above impulse origin.
Triggered means last candle high is strictly above pullback trigger and low strictly above pullback low; close above trigger is reported separately and is not required.
Impulse must meet the configured minImpulse threshold; volume ratio is pullback mean quote volume divided by impulse mean quote volume.
not_supported: Short direction, any requested direction parameter, 5m/15m or other cadences
A full input-candle schema/quality validator; this parity fixture uses valid synthetic rows

research_acceptance_guard.rule: Before accepting a candidate, require every target-cadence candle from ten bars before impulse start through signal end to exist in the full-valid aggregate. A missing bar rejects; do not bridge gaps.
research_acceptance_guard.status: Research-only check, independent of production scanner behavior.

fixture_design.source: Deterministic synthetic OHLCV generated in research/scanner_parity.py; no exchange data.
cases: pattern gap rejection and unsupported cadence/options
tradfi watch, high-triggered-but-close-below, inclusive 50% and rejected over-50% retracement, exact minimum-impulse threshold
tradfi gap rejection, unsupported 5m and mirrored-short inputs, future-row invariance
limitations: Finite hand-designed fixtures do not establish exhaustive equivalence for arbitrary rows, malformed inputs, option combinations, duplicate timestamp semantics, numeric edge cases, or all combinations of long/short outputs.
No performance, predictive, execution, or trading claim.

saved_1m_data_inventory.inspection: Offline git-index inventory of committed files; no acquisition or untracked/local file scan.
saved_1m_data_inventory.result: No committed path named for 1m was found. The committed candle CSV.GZ snapshots are explicitly named 5m and 15m, with corresponding 5m and 15m event files.
saved_1m_data_inventory.policy: No 5m/15m upsampling or other synthetic historical data was treated as 1m.

empirical_gaps_not_tested: No saved committed 1m dataset is available; actual historical scanner parity and event counts were not tested.
No validation of live application call sites, UI filtering, scanner version drift, or every option combination.
No 15m scanner parity: pattern.js accepts only 1m inputs and 1m/5m aggregate settings; tradfiPattern is fixed to 1m.
No empirical comparison against breakout.js or frozen 11-arm scanner family; outside this bounded deliverable.
